source_location: Slide 8 'Broad Inputs (2/3)' (PDF page 8): 'Year on year investment limits for different technologies: 25-32 GW per year for Solar'
notes: Central and high: 32 GW/yr, the upper end of CEA's stated band and so the published cap on what may be added in a year. Low: 25 GW/yr, the lower end of CEA's stated band, used as a conservative cap. The deck lists these limits among the inputs of the NEP 2022-32 study (slides 7-9, before 'Final NEP results'), so they are applied over the NEP horizon to FY2031-32. For comparison, NEP Table 5.9a (printed page 5.14, PDF page 140) implies 26.3 GW/yr in 2022-27 (131,570 MW / 5) and 35.8 GW/yr in 2027-32 (179,000 MW / 5); the 2027-32 plan rate is above 32 GW/yr and neither document explains the difference. CUF: the deck gives no number, so the CEA NEP national solar CUF is used: '22% CUF of Solar PV is on aggregated All India basis considering existing Solar PV, Rooftop solar and future PV plants' (CEA NEP 2022-32, replies to comments item 21.21, printed page xlii, PDF page 44, https://cpr-prod-cclw-document-admin-store.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/NEP_2022_32_FINAL_GAZETTE_English.pdf). Secondary source.
